sources.quote: SUP-G,Minuterie Germanasca S.r.l.,"steel stampings, clips, pins"

findings.why: Viteria Lanzo is not in the supplier master, which lists only SUP-G. A person must say whether it is a known supplier and what its standing is.

sources.quote: 4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: The change moves CL-115 to a new source. No 3.1 certificate from Viteria Lanzo is in the documents, so the supplier quality engineer must obtain or confirm it.

sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: No approved supplier list or other controlled record covers Viteria Lanzo for CL-115, the receiving plant and the customer. The documents also do not say which plant or customer applies. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so a person must check the list.
